lines.speaker: Franky
lines.text: So, you're the one who made it all the way here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Out of my way! I have a mission to finish.

lines.speaker: Franky
lines.text: I can't let you pass that easily. A real man never backs down from a promise!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Then prove your words with your fists!

lines.speaker: Franky
lines.text: Show me what you've got! SUUUUPER!
